decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed erection of a single storey rear  extension, because of its position, design and appearance would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 37 Lulworth Avenue and would be complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV B.1.1 (New development), H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, (2003)    .
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.30 am  to 5.0 pm  on Mondays to Friday and 8.30 am  to 12.00 noon on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing house.
